notes.title: AI scoring hotfix
notes.content: Small update to fix a bug where AI scores were not being cleared, and carried over into replay games.

notes.title: Minor Update: Sound settings
notes.content: Fixed bug where sound volume options weren't working in game.

notes.title: MP and saves ease of use changes
notes.content: This is a small update to add some ease-of-use additions to the saved games and MP set up, clarifying things like players choosing player slots and telling the host when they're ready to play.
